welcome_message:
Create an AAI RAG application

Governed retrieval-augmented generation: chunking pipeline over governed source data, a declared vector index (or external Azure AI Search), traced grounded generation, and a groundedness release gate.

project_name.description: Project and bundle name. NOTE: apply template updates deliberately — generated projects record their template version in .aai-template.json
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

application_name.description: Application identifier used in tags and traces

repository_url.description: Required absolute HTTPS URL of this project's real Git repository; Hub registration rejects example and placeholder URLs
repository_url.pattern_match_failure_message: Use an absolute HTTPS repository URL without credentials, spaces, a query string, or a fragment.

model_provider.description: Model provider. Choose `databricks` (recommended default: gateway-ready serving endpoint, no extra auth wiring; the enterprise attaches AI Gateway rate limits and usage tracking) unless your team already operates its own Foundry resource — then `foundry` calls it directly with Entra tokens. Either way, application code only uses the logical name

model_deployment.description: Databricks serving endpoint name or Foundry deployment name

foundry_endpoint.description: Foundry project endpoint ending in /api/projects/<project> (only asked for Foundry models)

judge_deployment.description: Approved gateway-fronted Databricks serving endpoint used by LLM judges

retrieval_provider.description: Retrieval provider. `databricks_ai_search` keeps data, governance, and billing inside the workspace (best when your documents already live in Unity Catalog); `azure_ai_search` fits corpora indexed outside Databricks or shared with non-Databricks consumers. Both are keyless and expose the same search contract

search_endpoint.description: Azure AI Search service or Databricks AI Search endpoint

embedding_deployment.description: Embedding deployment or endpoint name. Its embedding dimension must match the search index's vector field (the config default assumes 1536, e.g. text-embedding-3-small); index, embeddings, and chunking change together as one release

aai_core_volume.description: Unity Catalog volume holding aai-core wheels

aai_core_pip_source.description: pip-installable aai-core source used only by credential-free CI; MUST resolve to exactly aai_core_version (default: the release git tag; for an internal index use 'aai-core=={{.aai_core_version}}'). Runtime jobs always install the checksum-pinned volume wheel

source_table.description: Governed source table of documents (columns: id, content, source_uri). The chunk pipeline writes <source_table>_chunks with Change Data Feed enabled (Databricks retrieval only)

prompt_version.description: Exact immutable Prompt Registry version evaluated by the release job; update this after registering a new prompt
prompt_version.pattern_match_failure_message: Use a positive integer Prompt Registry version.

knowledge_version.description: Bounded non-secret immutable identifier for the externally managed knowledge/chunk/index snapshot evaluated by the release gate
knowledge_version.pattern_match_failure_message: Use 1-128 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, colons, slashes, plus signs, or hyphens.

success_message:
{{.project_name}} created.

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. python3.12 scripts/setup_dev.py     # preflight + isolated setup
  3. make check                          # tests + deterministic gate
  4. python scripts/register_prompt.py   # note the immutable version
  5. python evals/evaluate.py --prompt-version <version>  # note decision_run_id
  6. python scripts/promote_prompt.py --version <version> --decision-run-id <run-id> --to validation
  7. make bundle-validate bundle-deploy

Run `make help` for every available target.
